findings.reason: the instruction and the done-when disagree about the same locus, and a worker implementing per the instruction ships a definition the gate the section names will still dock.
findings.text: §9 tells the worker `dr_dz_zero_point` "loses only its IDS path", but its registered definition (`imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/locus_registry.yml:838-842`) carries three DD references, not one: the IDS path ("DD: equilibrium/time_slice/boundary_separatrix/dr_dz_zero_point"), the DD field `midplane_identifier`, and the option value `'dr_dz_zero_sep'`; the same section's first done-when asserts "no locus definition names a DD field, an IDS path or an option value", so an edit made exactly as instructed leaves a DD field and an option value and fails the section's own test

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — commit `0e43cde` resolves and its message matches §9's account ("undefined for a limited plasma … disagrees with poloidal_angle"); `conventions/concepts.yml` relation and the `poloidal_angle`, `outboard_midplane`, `inboard_midplane`, `outboard_midplane_separatrix` and `dr_dz_zero_point` referents all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — both of §9's done-whens are measurable and each names a negative control: test 1 must fail on the old `outboard_midplane` and the old `outboard_midplane_separatrix` text, and test 2 on a planted definition that drops the midplane-height or the axis-side part; the `dR/dZ`/`dr/dz` clause is scoped to the three midplane loci, so `dr_dz_zero_point` is exempt, which is the correction the prior `done_when-1` asked for.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §9's done-when names no scratch path; its runs record `EXIT=` under the node's evidence grant, not a temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §9 introduces no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag into code, and its new test carries no plan identifier.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §9's instruction for `dr_dz_zero_point` ("loses only its IDS path") under-scopes the edit, so the mechanism the section names cannot produce the section's own done-when.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §9 carries one deliverable, that every locus definition states its concept and names no DD field.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §9's declared link `concept-and-notation-registry#s4` resolves and matches §8's done-when ("The release in §4 carries this section with §7 and §9"); the dependent→release direction is the plan's one convention, already settled by an earlier review.
